entities.name: Thomas Zhao Fengwu
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Thomas Zhao Fengwu was a Chinese Catholic prelate, verbist, bishop of Yanzhou, prisoner for faith. He was recognized as a legal bishop by both the Holy See and the government of the People's Republic of China. Zhao was proficient in German.
